description: Get one run's details. Pass `executionId` (from list_runs source history) for step-by-step status, durations and recorded inputs and outputs. Pass `instanceId` (from run_workflow or list_runs source instances) for a durable run's state, step history, output and error, plus `awaitingEvents`: the event types it is parked on, which control_run send_event must use. Pass exactly one of the two. Set `simple` with instanceId to get only the status, for cheap polling.

executionId.description: A run-log id from list_runs (source history).

instanceId.description: A durable run's id from run_workflow or list_runs (source instances).

simple.description: With instanceId only: skip step detail and return status and stepCount.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: get_run
title: Get run
